name: Nakorika
backstory: Child of Nakoran and Fenserika; raised in Salthos Cruzados on waits near the Salthos house's own square on..., and carries some knowledge of Gorff.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Learned that Darius has died.
Grew up hearing: Had a child with Nierius, named Fenrius.
Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Had a child with Prince Doran, named Dorakus.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Dorakus and Darnus now have a child, Doraknus.
Heard that Fenserika and Niekus now have a child, Fenekus.

criterion.standard: holds themself accountable to Toll Ledger Arrears, whatever it costs
criterion.wasted_life: one that never had to answer for Toll Ledger Arrears
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: sits in judgment at the square when it's his turn, leans on the clerks' records more than his own memory, and walks the crossing at dusk out of old habit

arc.premise: Nakorika wants the toll arrears named outright at the next petition day rather than referred up and quietly shelved again - a plain number, read aloud, that Gorff has to answer to.
